title: Open a new tab in Brave
steps: Select the + (New tab) button to the right of your open tabs.
Or press Ctrl+T to open a new tab and jump to it.
Closed one by mistake? Ctrl+Shift+T reopens the last closed tab.

source.title: What keyboard shortcuts can I use in Brave?

title: Bookmark a page in Brave
steps: Press Ctrl+D, or select the bookmark icon at the right end of the address bar, to bookmark the page.
Press Ctrl+Shift+B to show or hide the Bookmarks bar.
Press Ctrl+Shift+O to open the Bookmarks Manager.

source.title: What keyboard shortcuts can I use in Brave?

title: Open a new tab in Chrome
steps: Select New tab (+) next to the last tab on the right.

title: Create and find bookmarks in Chrome
steps: Go to the site you want to visit again.
To the right of the address bar, select Bookmark (the star).
To find bookmarks, select More (⋮) > Bookmarks and lists > Bookmark Manager, or type @bookmarks in the address bar and press Tab.
